pd_dollhouse_2.summary: Nora swears the children to secrecy about the stranger and sends them away.
Nora fights her panic, has the tree brought in, and resolves to please Torvald.
Helmer returns and Nora denies anyone visited, then admits Krogstad came.
Helmer scolds Nora for lying, patronizingly calling her his songbird, then forgives.
Helmer settles by the stove while Nora busies herself, then calls to him.

s01074.summary: Gloria serves cake at a closet office party while a stranger watches.
The tall man asks about huddles; Gloria probes who he is and wins him with cake.
Bertram reveals the closets are being made efficient; Gloria and Dez push back.
A runaway toner cart nearly topples the cake and everyone grabs at once.
Frozen together, they joke that alignment is achieved and Bertram almost smiles.
The mailroom kid asks about cake, and Gloria orders another slice cut.

s01116.summary: Teddy tastes his ex's wine and Camila teases that he finds it sour.
Henrik praises the wine, and Izabella introduces him as her fiance.
Teddy congratulates them stiffly, drains his glass, and Camila offers another.

s01081.summary: Rocco counts cash while Sal and Lena press sweating Timothy about the bag.
A creak upstairs alarms the group; Rocco dismisses it as a stuffed possum.
Another creak; Sal demands the bag and Timothy admits it isn't the money.
Timothy confesses he was forced by the man upstairs.
A figure descends the stairs and kills the light, plunging them into darkness.

s01028.summary: Orsolya and Tavi drift through a derelict station, hailing anyone aboard.
Orsolya finds sabotaged wiring and hides her fear from trembling Tavi.
Thuds echo through the ring; Orsolya insists they're far away, unconvincingly.
A louder scrape; Orsolya announces departure and tows Tavi to the airlock.
One polite knock follows; she seals the hatch and sits shaken.

s00015.summary: Around Marrow's empty coat, Hetty asks who saw him; Soli explains the locks.
Mei-Ling and Hetty probe Soli and Bastian's stories about the keys and alibis.
Mei-Ling catches Pratt contradicting himself, and Hetty notes he has a key.
Pratt needles Mei-Ling about the coat and insists someone must explain.
Bastian notes Pratt's wet cane; Hetty demands to know where Marrow is.

s01072.summary: Renata contentedly eats lunch in her secret crawlspace above the office.
The intercom announces an audit and names her long-abandoned desk.
A flashlight beam sweeps the crawlspace behind her; she whispers oh no.

s01107.summary: Milo climbs to the rooftop where Sadie sits, and she makes room.
They listen to the radio and share a cracker in silence.
Playful shoving nearly sends Sadie off the ledge; Milo catches her sleeve.
Sadie offers her hand and they climb down together as the song swells.

s00007.summary: Rosalind packs her late father's trophies in the closed bowling alley.
Pearl recalls their father's 290 game; Devante corrects it to 289.
Devante calls the trophies junk, and Pearl laments the buyer's gym plans.
Devante walks lane nine one last time as Rosalind warns about scuffs.
Pearl says Rosalind was meant to close up; Rosalind refuses all help.
Pearl offers their father's old bowling shirt; Devante lays it in the box.
Pearl buttons up and leaves, promising coffee in the morning.
Devante hands Rosalind the last trophy, learns its story, and kills the radio.

pd_earnest_5.summary: The couples praise the men's courage and fall into each other's arms.
Merriman announces Lady Bracknell, and the couples spring apart in alarm.
Lady Bracknell forbids Jack all contact with Gwendolen.
Questioned about Bunbury, Algernon flusteredly declares him exploded and dead.
Learning of Cecily's engagement, Lady Bracknell coldly interrogates Jack about her origins.

s01070.summary: A stranger wades out of the flooded mill with hands up.
Okafor interrogates Teodor; Halvorsen notes he came from the enemy bank.
Engines approach; Okafor kills the lantern but the radio gives only static.

pd_earnest_3.summary: Chasuble, Miss Prism and Cecily leave the reconciled brothers alone.
Jack orders Algy out, but Merriman has already unpacked his luggage.
Algernon and Jack trade insults about clothes, duty and Cecily.
Cecily returns; Algernon laments their painful parting and she flirts back.

s01030.summary: Strozzi replays her tape notes beside the projector in the abandoned planetarium.
She finds a fresh greasy thumbprint and the projector is still warm.
She notices fresh chalk stars on the dome as the projector clicks.

s00008.summary: June claims maintenance while secretly coordinating a heist over her headset.
Wallace shares his late wife's joke about Orion, and June laughs.
June slips on the headset again and covers clumsily.
Wallace reveals he knew all along and lets the heist happen.
He offers coffee and asks them to leave the telescope; June relays it.

s01053.summary: Wardens in an air raid shelter mark the time as bombers drone.
Control warns of incendiaries; Edmund orders helmets on and spars with Alf.
Control reports a strike on Edmund's shop, where his daughter lives.
Defying orders, Edmund leaves Vera in charge and goes up with Alf.

s01055.summary: Philomena stirs sauce and needles Artur about missing Sundays and her late husband.
Philomena sees through the visit and demands Artur say what he practiced.
Artur tells her she is sick; she already knew.
Artur reveals they want to move her to care; she sees through it.
Tearful, Philomena seats them and feeds Soledad, joking darkly about her absence.
She shares the recipe's true ingredient, her devotion; Artur takes her hand.

s00011.summary: Prudence announces insufficient synergy at an absurd meeting about meetings.
Barnaby and Delphine touch fingers reaching for a pen and both recoil.
A pigeon drops something; Prudence takes it offline and forbids a mop.
Barnaby's deck is one useless slide; everyone pretends not to see.
Prudence lists no action items and defers Delphine's lanyard to an unscheduled review.
Barnaby and Delphine wait side by side at a long-broken elevator.

s00009.summary: Down nine in the final jam, Tamara coaches tense Bruise on the bench.
At the line, Dot and Bruise trade jabs while Tamara keeps coaching.
Dot needles Bruise about praying; Tamara mentions her mother, angering her.
The jammers lock eyes in silence until the whistle shrieks.

s01054.summary: A frightened woman locks into a motel room and checks every corner.
She tests her tape recorder and logs her first day on the run.
Playback reveals an unspoken whisper saying I'm in the room, then vanishes.
A key tag reminds her she is Lena Marsh; she recites her identity.
The recorder speaks to her of tomorrow; she rips out and smashes the cassette.
The bathroom light and doorknob move alone; Lena hides under the bed.
The cracked cassette speaks of day two; Lena whispers back, and the lamp clicks on.

s00014.summary: On a ferry courtroom, both counsel agree and the judge prepares to adjourn.
Lieutenant Arroyo interrupts with a newly found engine room log.
The judge confronts Percy with his signature in the engineer's log.
De Luca and Osei clash over ambush versus evidence; the judge restores order.
Percy whispers to De Luca, who pales and asks who Annabelle is.

s01094.summary: Helena pries up a floorboard and finds Warrick's hidden journal.
She reads the journal's ominous note and a star circled with NO.
Grant scolds her for not waiting; she spots another person's footprints.
Helena follows the footprints to a door as a tall man emerges.
Helena demands whether Warrick's student killed him and what the star is.
The dome closes; Helena throws the journal and the man lunges in darkness.

s01024.summary: Oyelaran presents the contract, and Hartmann objects that it was never signed.
The argument escalates into forgery and slander accusations.
Vance splinters her gavel and orders them to sit; silence falls.
